result:
Done. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (12 tests, 10 new), and the full `bunx guren gate` (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, test) all pass.

**What was built**

- **Storage.** Two new tables in `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration under `db/migrations/20260925051253_add_comments/`. The `comments` table has `id`, `post_id`, `user_id`, `body`, `created_at`. The `comment_reports` table has `comment_id`, `user_id`, `created_at` with a composite primary key on the pair, so a repeat report is a no-op.
- **Models.** `Comment` (fillable `body` only, belongs to author and post, has many reports) and `CommentReport`, plus a `comments` hasMany on `Post`. The hide threshold lives on the Comment model as `HIDE_REPORT_THRESHOLD`.
- **Routes and controller.** `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id`, and `POST /comments/:id/report`, all behind the existing `auth` alias so guests get the same redirect to `/login`. The comment body schema (1 to 2000 characters after trimming) is bound to the route, so a bad body answers 422 the same way a bad post title does. Report always answers 204 and inserts only when no row exists yet.
- **Authorization.** A `CommentPolicy` registered in `AuthorizationProvider`: delete is allowed to the comment's author or the post's author, anyone else gets 403.
- **Post page.** `PostController.show` now passes `comments` (`{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`, oldest first, minus comments with three or more distinct reporters). `posts/Show.tsx` renders them with author name and time, a comment form for signed-in users, Delete where allowed, and Report through the typed API client with a reload of the comments prop.
- **Post deletion** removes the post's comments and their reports inside a transaction, rather than trusting SQLite's cascade.
- **Tests** in `tests/CommentController.test.ts` cover every contract point: guest redirect with nothing stored, validation, ordering and author shape, both allowed deleters, 403 for a third user, repeated-report idempotence, hiding after three reporters while the row stays, and cascade on post deletion.
- **ADR** `docs/adr/0002-...` records the moderation rule and links the Comment, CommentReport, and Post entities.

Summary: I added community-moderated comments to the blog. Schema and migration changes live in `db/schema.ts` and `db/migrations/20260925051253_add_comments/`; new code is `app/Models/Comment.ts`, `app/Models/CommentReport.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts`, and `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts`. Existing files changed are `routes/web.ts` (three new auth-guarded routes), `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` (comments prop on show, cascading destroy), `app/Models/Post.ts` (comments relation), `app/Providers/AuthorizationProvider.ts` (policy binding), and `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` (comment list, form, Delete and Report controls). Tests are in `tests/CommentController.test.ts`, the decision is recorded in `docs/adr/0002-community-moderation-hides-comments-after-three-reports.md`, and the generated `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests were regenerated.
